svg.title: Mockup 09: Event profile: save, load, export, start from the demo
svg.text: 09 · Event profile: save, load, export, start from the demo
The event as set up, in one file. Loading says what it replaces, part by part, before it does; people, orders and photos are never touched.
Use case: an organiser starts a new event from the demo or from last time’s profile, and keeps a copy before a big change (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: Everything this event is set up with: the run of show, menus, screens, the look, the switches and every part’s settings.
Keep a copy before a big change.

Notes: a profile carries the module switches (D8).
Loading saves a copy of the current setup first, so a wrong load is undone by loading it back (U8).
